info.title: BlitzBoard Public API
info.description:
Organization-scoped public integration API for seasons, teams, players, and schedules.
Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer bb_live_...` (API key, not a login JWT).
Generate keys from Organizations → organization detail at https://live.blitzboardstats.com/organizations.
List seasons via GET /v1/blitz-api/seasons and pass `_id` as `season` when creating a team.

tags.name: Seasons
tags.description: List seasons to use when creating teams

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: Team CRUD scoped to the API key organization

ApiKeyBearer.description: Public integration API key (`bb_live_...`). Not a login JWT.

Forbidden.description: Outside API key organization scope or insufficient permissions

get.description: List teams for the organization bound to the API key. organizationId is injected from the key.

post.description: Create a team in the API key organization. Do not send organizationId in the body.

Create a single player. Requires header idem-key (or Idempotency-Key): a client-generated unique string for this create intent. Reusing a key that already created a player returns 409 Conflict and does not create a duplicate. Generate a new key for every new player. See Concepts → Idempotency key.

parameters.name: idem-key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique string for this create intent (UUID recommended). Also accepted as Idempotency-Key. Same key reused after a successful create → 409 Conflict (Idempotency key already used). Missing → 400.

get.description: List schedules for a team. Each item `_id` is the `scheduleId` used for detail/update/delete.

post.description: teamId comes from the path, not the body.

get.description: List available seasons. Use `_id` as `season` when creating a team. Optional filters: year, season name.
Get one schedule by `scheduleId` (the schedule document `_id`) under a team.

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Schedule document Mongo id (from create or list). This is the schedule detail id.

patch.description: Update a schedule by `scheduleId` under a team. `teamId` comes from the path.

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Schedule document Mongo id (from create or list). This is the schedule detail id.

delete.description: Delete a schedule by `scheduleId` under a team.

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Schedule document Mongo id (from create or list). This is the schedule detail id.
